nodes.label: CloudDash 5-Day MVP Plan
nodes.rationale: Focus on demoable code over over-engineering; use FastAPI for async parity with Express and ChromaDB for zero-infra local persistence.

nodes.label: RAG Pipeline Concept
nodes.rationale: Ingest KB JSON -> Split -> Embed -> ChromaDB; Retrieve via similarity; Use as context in LLM prompt.

nodes.label: Handover Protocol
nodes.rationale: Pull-based protocol where target agent explicitly acknowledges handover; enables validation of context completeness and fallback to Triage/Escalation.

nodes.label: Guardrails & Safety
nodes.rationale: Input guardrails block prompt injection; output guardrails redact PII and verify KB grounding to prevent hallucinations.

nodes.label: Graphify Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Use graphify query for focused context to save tokens and improve relevance over raw grep/source browsing.

nodes.label: FastAPI
nodes.rationale: Native async support like Express, automatic OpenAPI documentation, and Pydantic-based data validation.

nodes.label: ChromaDB
nodes.rationale: Local vector store that persists to disk, avoiding external infrastructure costs and setup for the MVP.

nodes.label: Agent Registry
nodes.rationale: Declarative YAML configuration allows adding new agents without modifying core orchestrator code.
